edtrace_backend.title: edtrace backend: Python tracer package (local copy)
edtrace_backend.sha_source: no .git directory under tools/edtrace; discover_repo.py records a sha256 per module in discovered.json instead
edtrace_backend.anchor_convention: execute.py:L232-L245  (path relative to tools/edtrace/backend/src/edtrace, 1-based inclusive line range)
edtrace_backend.note: Seven modules, 792 lines: execute.py (tracer, CLI), execute_util.py (text/image/video/link/plot/note renderings), reference.py (Reference + label), arxiv_util.py (arXiv page scrape), file_util.py (download cache, relativize), examples.py (demo program), __init__.py (public API).

edtrace_frontend.title: edtrace frontend: React/Vite trace viewer (local copy)
edtrace_frontend.note: TraceViewer.jsx (946 lines) is the whole viewer: URL-param state, keyboard stepping, env merging, value and rendering display. App.jsx/main.jsx are router + mount; utils.js has getLast. Indexed by regex only (discovered.json frontend_modules); no JS parser was used.

edtrace_readme.title: edtrace README.md
edtrace_readme.note: Hello-world program, the `python -m edtrace.execute -m hello` command, var/traces/<module>.json output location, dev/production viewer setup. Anchors are README.md:L<n>.

cs336_lectures.title: CS336 official executable lectures (official/lectures)
cs336_lectures.note: Used only to show how the directives are used in practice (lecture_02.py). Anchors are lecture_02.py:L<n>.
